@graph.description: Destination-agnostic planning help for affordable trips — areas to stay, transport, costs, food, safety and itineraries.

acceptedAnswer.text: Cards and contactless are widely accepted in cities. Keep small local notes for markets, tips and rural transport.

mainEntity.name: Is a travel eSIM or a local SIM better?

acceptedAnswer.text: An eSIM works before you land and needs no shop visit. A local SIM is often cheaper per gigabyte. Compare both against your trip length and data needs.

mainEntity.name: What is the cheapest way to get from the airport?

acceptedAnswer.text: Usually the scheduled airport bus or the rail link. Compare total door-to-door time, not just the ticket price, and check when the last service runs.
